slides.headlineRest: Fixes Critical CVSS 10.0 Arbitrary Code Execution Flaw.
slides.body: Adobe has issued urgent security updates for its enterprise marketing platform, Campaign Classic. A critical vulnerability, rated 10.0 on the CVSS scale, could allow attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected systems. This high-severity flaw stems from incorrect authorization and does not require any user interaction to be exploited. It is crucial for all users of Adobe Campaign Classic to apply these security patches without delay to safeguard against potential threats.
